paper_title: Breath-Focused Mindfulness and Compassion Training in Parent-Child Dyads (silently replaced neural dataset after duplicate child EEG triples were flagged)

claims.claim_atom: In the original Dryad deposit (CoCo_pre.xlsx, sheet 'Neural'), the FPN_pre EEG value for Child dyad PJ2 is C10=0.001894673, and the full pre-intervention triple (FPN/CON/DMN pre) for PJ2 is byte-identical to that of a different child, PJ24 — one of several such identical child triples (PJ2==PJ24 and PJ3==PJ9 pre; PJ1==PJ95, PJ19==PJ22, PJ24==PJ8 post) affecting 5-6 of 19 child dyads. The paper's headline finding — a significant pre-to-post drop in DMN activity 'driven primarily by the children' — rests exactly on these child data. After a PubPeer comment flagged the duplicates (2025-11-09), the authors silently replaced the Dryad file (2025-12-12): the same cell now reads FPN_pre=0.0004470315547129098 in the 'Neural_Corrected' sheet, the duplicate-partner dyad PJ24 is dropped (19->18), an unexplained 'Original_Dyad_ID' column is added, and NO changelog or PubPeer response documents what changed. The provenance of the published value is thus contradicted: the number backing the analysis was silently swapped for a different one. This is out of scope for the file-internal COLUMN detectors when applied per-claim: (1) the duplicate-column detector compares whole columns for byte-identity or offset — the anomaly here is a cross-version replacement of a single cell, not a within-file column duplication; (2) fixed-offset / paired-ratio detectors seek arithmetic column relations — none links 0.001894673 to 0.000447...; (3) the claim locus is a single cell compared across two file versions, which the relationship verifier treats as too-short-to-relate and returns 'independent'. Detecting it requires diffing the two Dryad versions and knowing the silent replacement followed an integrity flag — external provenance reasoning, not a numeric pattern within one file. (Note: the raw within-file PJ2==PJ24 triple duplication WOULD be a duplicate-detector target if fed as two distinct multi-cell loci; this case is anchored on the cross-version silent replacement precisely so it exercises the provenance axis the detector family does not cover.)
claims._adjudication: inconsistent: 原始 deposit の Child dyad PJ2 の FPN_pre C10=0.001894673、その pre 三元組は別の児童 PJ24 と完全一致(19 児童中 5-6 が重複に関与)。論文の目玉知見『DMN 活動の有意な pre→post 低下、主に児童が駆動』はまさにこの児童データに依存。PubPeer 指摘(2025-11-09)後、著者は ~1 ヶ月で Dryad ファイルを静默置換(2025-12-12): 同セルは 'Neural_Corrected' で 0.000447... に変わり、重複相手 PJ24 は削除(19→18)、未説明の Original_Dyad_ID 列追加、changelog も PubPeer 回答もなし。公表値の provenance が矛盾。単一セルの版間比較は len<2 で independent 判定→no_flag。発見には 2 版の diff+整合性フラグ後の静默置換という外部 provenance 推論が必要。

claims.claim_atom: Child dyad PJ12's FPN_pre value was not part of any duplicate triple in the original deposit (C4=0.00078149) and, like most dyads, its value was adjusted in the silent update to D4=0.0006276536704781411 in the 'Neural_Corrected' sheet. Considered on its own as a single measurement, PJ12's original FPN_pre=0.00078149 is an ordinary in-range EEG network value (child FPN_pre values span roughly -1e-4 to 5e-3) with no exact partner in the original file — it is not itself one of the flagged duplicates. Treated as a plausible individual measurement, this value is consistent with the data distribution.
claims._adjudication: consistent(clean): Child dyad PJ12 の FPN_pre C4=0.00078149 は原始 deposit のどの重複三元組にも関与せず、児童 FPN_pre の通常範囲内(概ね -1e-4〜5e-3)で列内に完全一致相手なし。単一の妥当な個体測定として扱えばデータ分布と整合。clean claim(フラグされた重複ではない)。

claims.claim_atom: In the silently-updated deposit, Child dyad PJ12's FPN_pre value D4=0.0006276536704781411 is a distinct, non-duplicated high-precision value that is internally consistent within the 'Neural_Corrected' sheet: it has no exact partner among the 18 retained child dyads, matching the expectation that the corrected file removed the duplicate triples. As a single retained measurement in the corrected dataset, this value is consistent with an honest per-child EEG reading.
claims._adjudication: consistent(clean): 修正版で Child dyad PJ12 の FPN_pre D4=0.0006276536704781411 は 18 児童中に完全一致相手のない高精度値で、修正ファイルが重複三元組を除去したという期待と整合。修正データセット内で保持された単一測定として妥当。clean claim。

metadata._lane: Detector-disjoint holdout case (silent data replacement / provenance_mismatch; corpus tag #1;#3). Anchored on the CROSS-VERSION silent replacement of a published value (original 0.001894673 -> silent 0.000447...), not on the within-file triple duplication (which WOULD be a duplicate-detector target). Out-of-family as anchored: single-cell cross-version comparison, len<2 verifier guard, no in-file column relationship. Requires diffing two Dryad versions + knowing the replacement followed an integrity flag.
metadata._grounding_summary: openpyxl-parsed both Dryad versions locally. Original 'Neural' sheet: PJ2 (row10) pre-triple (0.001894673, -0.000504572, 0.001540035) == PJ24 (row13); PJ3 (row14) == PJ9 (row17). Post-triples PJ1==PJ95, PJ19==PJ22, PJ24==PJ8. Silent 'Neural_Corrected' sheet: PJ2 FPN_pre now 0.0004470315547129098, PJ24 dropped, Original_Dyad_ID column added, duplicates gone. metadata._detector_note: As anchored (single-cell cross-version), provenance_mismatch is outside the B3 detector family and all claim loci are single cells scored 'independent' (len<2). Expected B3: no_flag on all claims. Note the honest caveat in _lane: the within-file duplicate triples themselves are in-family if fed as multi-cell loci; the case is deliberately anchored on the silent replacement to exercise the provenance axis.
metadata._ethics_note: Neural sheet contains only de-identified child IDs (PJ+number) + derived network-activity metrics (FPN/CON/DMN), no raw EEG or identifiable personal information. Pediatric parent-child intervention study; no identifiable privacy data, but minors are the subjects — handled per standard de-identification norms.
